blind.description: The model is a classical decorative pedestal or display column. It consists of three distinct parts: a multi-tiered stepped square base, a fluted column shaft with alternating cream stone and golden vertical ribs, and a flared square capital featuring a relief of a golden sun face with radiating rays on each face beneath a flat square top. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or thin floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, melted, or fused. It stands on its own integrated stepped base, and the underside sits completely flat on the floor with no extra added ground slab or plinth. Materials and colours are pale cream/sandstone and polished gold; there are no plain black or unpainted areas, no text or labels visible, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: A square flat surface featuring a beige central square bordered by a raised golden rim, with the outer relief tips of the golden sun faces slightly protruding from the sides beneath the capital's edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 7 to 7.5 ft tall, standing noticeably taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (which reaches to the neck of the capital just below the sun face). The square base is approximately 2 to 2.5 ft wide, roughly twice the diameter of the scale figure's body.
